component.name: arc
component.summary: Modern, open-source 3D modeling built on a mesh geometry kernel

description.p: arc is a modern, open-source 3D modeling application for general design, architecture, and interior design workflows. It is built around a mesh-based geometry kernel written in Rust with a native desktop shell powered by Tauri.

ul.li: Primitive modeling - box, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus, and plane primitives with editable parameters
Sketch tools - circle, line, polyline, rectangle, dimension, and wall drawing with grid snapping
Solid generation - extrude, revolve, sweep, and loft profiles into solids
Architecture tools - walls, stairs, slabs, roofs, columns, beams, doors, and windows
Layers with visibility, locking, and color overrides
Full undo/redo history and multi-document editing

description.p: CAD UI and tool overhaul: 3D ViewCube with face/edge/corner hit zones, dedicated Sketch Mode, tool preview parity with B-rep solids, transform-aware CSG, and unified layout.
Truck kernel STEP import/export, bundling fixes, and zero-warning build.
Bug fixes and kernel migration groundwork.
Primitives, sketch tools, solid generation, architecture tools, layers, plugins, and OBJ and STL export.
